_doc: Machine-readable relay state. baton = who is actively working (idle|mac|linux). Only one host works at a time; git push atomicity enforces it. Edited by ledger/relay.py (automation) or the /relay-resume Claude skill (interactive). Task status: todo=ready, blocked=not implemented yet, running, done.

queue.desc: Both machines reproduce frozen Phase-0 baseline (seed 12345) before trusting cross-machine numbers
Ring-entry metering (RING_METER=wrap-follow+merge-meter). Lifts ring gap 65.8->94.8m (G1' PASS) but G3 FAILS: n_battery_dead 123->153 (entry holds -> hover drain); holds +29%. Flag kept, default OFF.

Isolation: RING_WRAP_FOLLOW only (no merge meter). WORSE than A7: gap 76.1m median but min 65.8 (G1' FAIL), n_battery_dead 240 (G3 FAIL, worse), completed 760. Ring-spacing enforcement is a dead end under this demand.

System-optimum marginal-cost tolling (TOLL_MODE, mult 2x). All hard gates PASS but NO benefit: holds +3.2%, completed +2, peak_backlog 999 unchanged. Ineffective because binding constraint is launch backlog, not routing. Flag kept, default OFF.

Demand-capacity balancing (DCB_MODE, per-origin-corridor fair-share airborne cap). THE lever. 5-seed sweep of DCB_CORRIDOR_SHARE {0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5}: monotone throughput<->latency curve. Chose share=1.5 (efficiency knee): completed +5.4%, holds -13%, battery_dead -38%, mean_wait +5.5%, makespan 6.22h (within 8h shift). (share=0.75 was safety-max: -76% deaths but makespan 8.67h exceeds shift.) Flag default OFF.

Promoted A6 (share=1.5) to new FROZEN baseline baseline_p1 = baseline_p0 + DCB_MODE. Files: params/baseline_p1.params, baseline_p1/{run_seeds.sh,aggregate.py,baseline_summary.json,metrics/}. Phase-3+ A/Bs measure against baseline_p1. baseline_p0 stays the env-parity handshake reference.

Speed control (SPEED_CONTROL, band factor 0.5) A/B vs baseline_p1. Ramps cruise speed down near a leader instead of full-tilt-then-stop; battery drains at actual velocity. 5-seed median: makespan 6.22->5.96h (-4.2%, recovers ~24% of DCB's add), total_hold -38.1%, conflicts -0.8%, deaths 76->75, completed flat; all hard gates PASS. Cost: mean_wait +3.2% (NOT recovered -- launch-queue bound, not air), reroutes +11.4%. Band sweep: 0.5 is the knee (1.0 over-packs -> conflicts+13%/G3 fail; 2.0 much worse). Flag default OFF.

Promoted baseline_p1 + A4 (SPEED_CONTROL band 0.5) to FROZEN baseline_p2. Files: params/baseline_p2.params, baseline_p2/{run_seeds.sh,aggregate.py,baseline_summary.json,metrics/}. Medians: completed 925, hold 6911, dead 75, makespan 5.96h, conflict 4049. Phase-4+ A/B against baseline_p2. baseline_p0 stays handshake ref. A-series done; RESULTS.md written.

A1 space-time reservation routing (RESV_ROUTING, SIPP-lite) implemented + baseline byte-identical (flag off), but DOES NOT SCALE: N=100 19.5s, N=200 >90s timeout (baseline 10s), N=1000 infeasible. Architecture mismatch -- reservation PLAN on a REACTIVE executor -> schedule divergence -> stuck -> reroute feedback -> super-linear wall time. Not A/B'd. Routing also not the bottleneck (A5 NEUTRAL). Scaffold kept flag-off. To make real: execute the schedule (honor bookings in speed/launch) or agent-tagged lifecycle -- larger build.
